title: Embalming Resin
html:
Source not yet observed

What it’s for

A gear-line reagent: a catalyst when crafting staves, making superior and flawless come up more often. One reagent lasts 10 crafts; a failed craft uses none.

Dropped by Mummy: Withered Husk, Mummy, Embalmed Priest, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Enchanter’s Table for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.

How to get it

No monster drops recorded for this item.
